title: Hourly Salary Calculator
h1: Hourly Salary Calculator — Wage and Annual Pay
seoTitle: Hourly Salary Calculator — Convert Wage and Pay
description: Convert an annual salary to an hourly wage, or an hourly rate to yearly pay, using hours per week and weeks worked. Runs locally.
intro: Enter either annual pay or an hourly rate. The other figure is calculated from your weekly hours and working weeks.
blurb: Convert annual salary and hourly wage using your real work schedule.
howItWorks: Choose whether the amount you know is annual salary or hourly wage.
Set hours per week and weeks per year. 40 hours and 52 weeks is a common full-time default.
Press Convert to see hourly, weekly, monthly and annual figures from the same schedule.
examples: 65000 a year at 40 hours and 52 weeks is about 31.25 per hour.
25 per hour at 40 hours and 52 weeks is 52000 a year.
A 48-week year lowers annual pay for the same hourly rate because fewer weeks are counted.

faq.q: Does this include taxes or benefits?
faq.a: No. Results are gross pay from rate and hours only. Taxes, overtime premiums and benefits are not applied.

faq.q: Why is monthly pay not salary divided by 12 in every case?
faq.a: Monthly is annual divided by 12 so it stays aligned with the yearly total. Weekly is hourly times hours.
